content:
After the major August launch of "Madden NFL 27," Apple Arcade will add "two player-favorite puzzle games" to its ad-free platform in September.

Block Blast!+ and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+" will be joining Apple's gaming subscription service in September.

Apple announced that its September Arcade update will bring two brand-new puzzle games to the platform: Block Blast!+ and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+". Both titles will arrive on Apple Arcade starting Thursday, September 3.

From the screenshots, Block Blast!+ looks especially well-suited for players seeking a Tetris-style experience.

On the other hand, "Art of Fauna" offers a slower pace, featuring more relaxed, nature-inspired artistic visuals.

As with every game on Apple Arcade, there are no ads and no in-app purchases — everything is included with an Apple Arcade subscription.

Apple also emphasized that starting tomorrow and throughout August, more new content will continue to roll out on Arcade:

You can read the full announcement here.

Apple Arcade offers an ad-free, zero in-app-purchase gaming experience, priced at US$6.99 per month after a one-month free trial. Through Family Sharing, a single subscription can be shared by up to five users.

Every Apple One bundle subscription also includes Apple Arcade.
